# ScaleFree_Hierarchy

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A structural property of energy landscapes where metastable states are organized in a self-similar, scale-invariant hierarchy across multiple levels of resolution. Offers a theoretical framework for designing and analyzing hierarchical memory architectures in TCC/iNEST, where information can be stored and retrieved at multiple abstraction levels.
